disclaimer: Good-faith, approximate seed data for a hackathon demo. Venues are real and believed to be operating as of generation, but capacities are rough standing figures compiled from third-party listings and model knowledge (see each record's 'source'), genres are loose tags, and coordinates come from OpenStreetMap Nominatim (geo_precision 'venue') or the city centre (geo_precision 'city'). Verify before relying on any value for real bookings.
